subject.title: feat(clients): provider-grouped model picker with fast, verbosity, and inherited-thinking controls

question: Should native macOS now adopt web-chat’s per-session Fast, verbosity, and inherited-thinking controls as a supported shared OpenClawKit contract, rather than keeping those controls web-only?
rationale: The patch adds new user-facing native controls and shared public client behavior; existing merged parity work supports the direction, but the provided discussion contains no explicit maintainer decision for this particular session-control surface.

options.title: Sponsor native parity
options.body: Accept the web-aligned controls after native proof demonstrates safe fresh and existing-session behavior.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Land only the provider-grouped model picker and defer session-setting controls until their ownership and UX are explicitly decided.

options.title: Keep controls web-only
options.body: Do not add these shared native session controls if the product should preserve a smaller macOS chat surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor native parity
recommendation.body: Accept the web-aligned controls after native proof demonstrates safe fresh and existing-session behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work shows direct ownership of the native-chat parity and shared Swift UI surfaces involved.
